comment: Template exclusion lists for different test types. 'exclude_list' contains permanent exclusions that apply to all tests. 'main_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from spoiler-minimal and multiclient tests. 'worldgen_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from world-generator tests. 'requires_javascript_helpers_list' contains games that require JavaScript helpers (excluded from new-rule-types prompts). 'exporter_fully_simplified_list' contains games whose exporters are fully simplified (excluded from helper-export and exporter-simplify prompts). This file is loaded by scripts/lib/test_utils.py.
